definitions: The main body or trunk of a tree, shrub, or other plant, typically rising above ground but sometimes subterranean.
The main upright part of a wine glass, goblet, or similar drinking vessel, connecting the bowl to the base.
The main structural part of a word, to which affixes may be added.
The main part of a ship or boat, especially the bow or stern.
examples: She held the glass by its stem.
The ship's stem cut through the waves.
